task: Clinical threshold evaluation for Timika severe TB triage
primary_interpretation: The spatial cavity-aware agentic stack improves continuous severity MAE and gives comparable severe-case discrimination to the MSE baseline. At raw Timika decision thresholds, gains are modest: precision/specificity and F1 improve slightly at thresholds 80 and 100, while sensitivity is not uniformly higher. Threshold 120 has very few positives in several countries and should be treated as supplementary.
important_caveat: Threshold metrics use raw predicted Timika score cutoffs. They are clinically interpretable but sensitive to prediction-scale calibration and severe-tail compression. AUROC/AUPRC should be emphasized as threshold-free triage discrimination metrics.
